description: Channel utilization and tx_allowed test vectors per spec/02-physical-link.md section 3.5 and spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md section 2a.7. Utilization is uint8 0..255 representing fractional airtime: util_norm = utilization / 255. select_tx_sf() returns (sf, tx_allowed) where tx_allowed=false when utilization > 200.
oracle_provenance: Independent calculation from spec pseudocode. AdaptiveSFSelect: if utilization > 150: SF += 2; if utilization > 200: return (12, false).

vectors.name: utilization_0_idle_channel
vectors.description: utilization=0: completely idle channel, no SF adjustment, tx allowed.

vectors.name: utilization_150_threshold_1_boundary
vectors.description: utilization=150: exactly at first threshold. SF += 2 per spec.

output.note: utilization=150 does NOT trigger SF+2 because condition is utilization > 150, not >=

vectors.name: utilization_151_above_threshold_1
vectors.description: utilization=151: just above first threshold, triggers SF += 2.

vectors.name: utilization_200_threshold_2_boundary
vectors.description: utilization=200: exactly at second threshold. tx still allowed per spec (> not >=).

output.sf_adjustment_reason: utilization > 150 triggers SF += 2, but utilization=200 exactly does not block tx

vectors.name: utilization_201_tx_blocked
vectors.description: utilization=201: above second threshold. tx NOT allowed.

vectors.name: utilization_255_saturated
vectors.description: utilization=255: fully saturated channel, tx blocked.

vectors.name: utilization_high_with_sf7_baseline
vectors.description: High utilization with SF7 baseline: SF capped at 12.

output.sf_adjustment_reason: utilization>200 forces return (12, false) per spec

vectors.name: utilization_moderate_density_high
vectors.description: utilization=100 but density=11: density triggers SF+2 before utilization check.

vectors.name: utilization_with_high_loss
vectors.description: utilization=100 with ema_loss=0.30: loss triggers additional SF+1.

vectors.name: utilization_combined_factors
vectors.description: utilization=151 and ema_loss=0.30: both factors apply.

output.sf_adjustment_reason: utilization > 150 sets SF=12, then ema_loss check would add +1 but already at max
